name: 黑粉束腰滑雪连体衣
nameEn: Black & Pink Corset One-Piece Ski Suit
description:
黑色修身滑雪连体衣，一件就是一整套，粉色豹纹翻领、胸前两颗粉色爱心和一排金色纽扣，束腰式剪裁很显身材；背后还有一颗粉色豹纹爱心。时髦又专业，适合双板。

## 面料与科技
- 三层复合面料，表面 Teflon® 涂层，防水、防油污
- 静水压 ≥20000mmH₂O（JIS L1092）
- 透湿量 ≥20000 g/m²·24h（JIS L1099）
- 耐磨 ≥15000 次（JIS L1096）
- 400 克绗缝棉填充，保暖锁温

## 设计细节
- 束腰式上身剪裁，修身显腰线
- 粉色豹纹翻领，背后粉色豹纹爱心
- 全身接缝压胶，雪水不易渗入
- 大腿内侧透气拉链，热了可以散热
- 袖口、裤脚防风设计
- 反向拉链口袋，内附雪镜擦拭布
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A slim-fit black one-piece — a complete outfit in one — with a pink leopard-print collar, two pink heart patches on the chest and a row of gold buttons. The corset-inspired bodice gives it a flattering, body-hugging shape, and there's a pink leopard heart on the back. Stylish and built for skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer composite fabric with Teflon® coating — waterproof and oil-resistant
- Waterproof rating ≥20,000 mmH₂O (JIS L1092)
- Breathability ≥20,000 g/m²/24h (JIS L1099)
- Abrasion resistance ≥15,000 cycles (JIS L1096)
- 400 g quilted insulation for warmth

## Design Details
- Corset-inspired bodice that defines the waist
- Pink leopard-print collar and heart patch on the back
- Fully taped seams to keep out snowmelt
- Inner-thigh vents to cool down
- Windproof cuffs and leg openings
- Reverse-zip pockets with a built-in goggle cleaning cloth
- Hand wash only; no bleach or ironing; hang dry in the shade

name: 复古水手服滑雪套装
description:
复古水手风滑雪套装：白色连帽外套 + 藏青色背带雪裤。经典水手领和领巾，袖子两侧是水手风荷叶袖，背带裤背后还有一颗白色爱心。单板、双板都适合。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 技术面料，防水、透气
- 薄款外壳，没有填充棉，里面按天气叠穿保暖层

## 设计细节
- 加宽加深的立体帽子，可以套在头盔外面，带调节抽绳
- 经典水手领，袖子两侧水手风荷叶袖
- 外套：全身接缝压胶、腋下透气拉链、可调抽绳、防风袖口、防雪裙，雪卡袋里附雪镜擦拭布
- 背带裤：反向拉链口袋防进雪、腰部背带可调、大腿内侧透气拉链、裤脚可以套在雪鞋外、防风裤脚
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A vintage sailor-inspired set: white hooded jacket + navy bib pants. Classic sailor collar and neckerchief, flutter-sleeve details on both sides, and a white heart on the back of the bibs. Great for snowboarding or skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3L technical fabric, waterproof and breathable
- Lightweight shell with no insulation — layer underneath to suit the weather

## Design Details
- Extra-roomy hood that fits over a helmet, with adjustable drawcords
- Classic sailor collar and flutter-sleeve details
- Jacket: fully taped seams, underarm vents, adjustable drawcords, windproof cuffs, powder skirt, and a goggle cleaning cloth in the ski pass pocket
- Bib pants: reverse-zip pockets that keep snow out, adjustable straps, inner-thigh vents, leg openings that fit over ski boots, windproof cuffs
- Hand wash only; no bleach or ironing; hang dry in the shade

name: 玫粉冲锋衣 + 黑色爱心背带裤套装
nameEn: Rose Pink Anorak + Black Heart Bib Set

items.size: 上衣 S · 背带裤 L

description:
玫粉色套头冲锋衣，黑色大披肩领配金色纽扣；黑色背带裤胸前是一颗毛绒爱心。爱心可以拆，背带裤两种穿法。注意尺码：上衣 S、背带裤 L。

## 面料与科技
- 3 层压胶工艺，Teflon 特氟龙面料
- 静水压防水 ≥20000mmH₂O（日标 JIS L1092）
- 透湿性 ≥20000 g/m²·24h（日标 JIS L1099）
- 耐磨 ≥15000 次（日标 JIS L1096）
- 上衣夹棉加厚，抵抗严寒

## 设计细节
- 上衣：全压胶、腋下透气拉链、反装拉链防灌雪、防风袖口、下摆抽绳锁温，雪卡袋内附清洁眼镜布
- 背带裤：毛绒爱心可拆卸、背带可调节、赠送腰带、大腿内侧透气拉链、防风脚口、全压胶

## 尺码
- 上衣 S：衣长 70cm、胸围 166cm、袖长 57cm、下摆围 98cm
- 背带裤 L：裤长 111.5cm、腰围 89cm、臀围 124cm、大腿围 76.8cm
descriptionEn:
A rose-pink pullover anorak with a big black cape collar and gold buttons, paired with black bib pants with a fluffy heart on the chest. The heart detaches, so the bibs can be worn two ways. Note the sizes: jacket S, bib pants L.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer bonded construction with Teflon™ fabric protector
- Waterproof rating ≥20,000 mmH₂O (JIS L1092)
- Breathability ≥20,000 g/m²/24h (JIS L1099)
- Abrasion resistance ≥15,000 cycles (JIS L1096)
- Insulated jacket for cold days

## Design Details
- Jacket: fully taped seams, underarm vents, reverse zippers that keep snow out, windproof cuffs, drawcord hem, and a goggle cloth in the ski pass pocket
- Bib pants: detachable fluffy heart, adjustable straps, belt included, inner-thigh vents, windproof cuffs, fully taped seams

## Size
- Jacket S: length 70 cm, chest 166 cm, sleeve 57 cm, hem 98 cm
- Bib pants L: length 111.5 cm, waist 89 cm, hips 124 cm, thigh 76.8 cm

name: 黑粉二合一冲锋衣 + 渐变胸衣背带裤套装
nameEn: Black & Pink 2-in-1 Jacket + Gradient Corset Bib Set
description:
可拆卸二合一：外层是黑粉拼色短款廓形外套，里面是一件收腰的粉色长袖冲锋衣，拉链一拉就分开，可以单穿也可以叠穿。配黑紫渐变胸衣背带裤，胸衣用硬纱鱼骨代替硬质材料，好看又舒服。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 3 层压胶工艺，Teflon 特氟龙面料
- 静水压防水 ≥20000mmH₂O（日标 JIS L1092）
- 透湿性 ≥20000 g/m²·24h（日标 JIS L1099）
- 耐磨 ≥15000 次（日标 JIS L1096）
- 3L 复合：特氟龙面料 + TPU 高透防水膜 + 加固层

## 设计细节
- 冲锋衣：帽围可调节、腋下透气拉链、内外层拆卸拉链、后腰口袋、防风袖口，雪卡袋内附清洁眼镜布
- 背带裤：胸衣设计、背带可调节、腰侧拼接弹力布、赠送腰带、大腿内侧透气拉链、防风脚口、全压胶

## 尺码（M）
- 内胆冲锋衣：衣长 57cm、肩宽 45cm、胸围 97cm、袖长 66.5cm、下摆围 110cm
- 背带裤：胸围 90–96cm、裤长 102cm、腰围 80cm、臀围 114cm、大腿围 75cm
descriptionEn:
A detachable 2-in-1: a cropped black-and-pink shell over a fitted pink long-sleeve jacket. Unzip to wear them separately or together. Paired with black-to-purple gradient corset bib pants — the bodice uses soft boning instead of rigid inserts, so it looks sharp and stays comfortable. Size M.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer bonded construction with Teflon™ fabric protector
- Waterproof rating ≥20,000 mmH₂O (JIS L1092)
- Breathability ≥20,000 g/m²/24h (JIS L1099)
- Abrasion resistance ≥15,000 cycles (JIS L1096)
- 3L laminate: Teflon™ face fabric + highly breathable TPU waterproof membrane + reinforcement layer

## Design Details
- Jacket: adjustable hood, underarm vents, zip-apart inner and outer layers, back waist pocket, windproof cuffs, and a goggle cloth in the ski pass pocket
- Bib pants: corset bodice, adjustable straps, stretch side panels, belt included, inner-thigh vents, windproof cuffs, fully taped seams

## Size (M)
- Inner jacket: length 57 cm, shoulder 45 cm, chest 97 cm, sleeve 66.5 cm, hem 110 cm
- Bib pants: chest 90–96 cm, length 102 cm, waist 80 cm, hips 114 cm, thigh 75 cm

name: 芭比联名白色印花滑雪套装（配粉色马甲）
nameEn: Barbie Collab White Print Ski Set with Pink Vest
description: BCG × 芭比联名款：奶白色连帽滑雪服，满印粉色 Barbie 字样，胸前黑色 BALLISTOCARDIOGRAM 字母，粉色袖口配金色纽扣。外面叠穿一件粉色工装马甲，多口袋很有设计感。整套包括上衣、马甲和雪裤。尺码 M。
descriptionEn: BCG × Barbie collab: a cream hooded ski jacket printed all over with pink Barbie logos, black BALLISTOCARDIOGRAM lettering across the chest, and pink cuffs with gold buttons. Layer the pink utility vest on top for a fun, pocket-packed look. The set includes the jacket, vest and snow pants. Size M.

name: 芭比联名黑粉西装滑雪上衣
nameEn: Barbie Collab Black & Pink Blazer Ski Jacket
description:
官方款名：芭比合作款黑粉廓形收腰西装滑雪服
把时装西服做成了滑雪服：宽肩窄腰、对折收腰，玫红翻领、粉色衬衫领和芭比领带，袖口翻边上绣着 Barbie。这款只有上衣，图里的芭比印花裤不包括。下单时可以选“加一条黑色滑雪裤”（款式随机，按套装价），也可以去 Mix & Match 自己搭一条雪裤。尺码 M。

## 设计细节
- 宽肩窄腰廓形，黑粉撞色领口和袖口
- 袖口 Barbie 刺绣
- 全压胶工艺、口袋反装拉链防灌雪
- 防风腰、防风袖口，雪卡袋内附清洁眼镜布

## 尺码（M）
- 衣长 76cm、肩宽 53.5cm、胸围 128cm、袖长 60.5cm、下摆围 130cm
- 模特身高 176cm，穿 M 码
descriptionEn:
Official name: Barbie Collab Black & Pink Tailored Waist Blazer Ski Jacket
A fashion blazer turned into a ski jacket: strong shoulders, a nipped-in waist, a hot-pink lapel, a pink shirt collar with a Barbie tie, and Barbie embroidery on the turned-back cuffs. This is the jacket only — the Barbie print pants in the photos aren't included. When you book, you can choose “Add black snow pants” (style may vary, charged at the set price), or pair your own pants in Mix & Match. Size M.

## Design Details
- Broad-shoulder, cinched-waist silhouette with black-and-pink collar and cuffs
- Barbie embroidery on the cuffs
- Fully taped seams; reverse-zip pockets keep snow out
- Windproof waist and cuffs; goggle cloth in the ski pass pocket

## Size (M)
- Length 76 cm, shoulder 53.5 cm, chest 128 cm, sleeve 60.5 cm, hem 130 cm
- Model is 176 cm (5'9") and wears M

name: 芭比联名黑粉西装 + 黑色滑雪裤

芭比联名黑粉西装滑雪上衣，搭一条基础款黑色滑雪裤（款式随机，尺码 M），按套装价收费。黑色雪裤百搭，让西装和芭比领带更突出。图里的芭比印花裤不包括。

## 尺码（M）
- 上衣：衣长 76cm、肩宽 53.5cm、胸围 128cm、袖长 60.5cm、下摆围 130cm

The Barbie collab black-and-pink blazer ski jacket paired with basic black snow pants (style may vary, size M), at the full-set price. Black pants go with everything and let the blazer and Barbie tie stand out. The Barbie print pants in the photos aren't included.

## Size (M)
- Jacket: length 76 cm, shoulder 53.5 cm, chest 128 cm, sleeve 60.5 cm, hem 130 cm

name: 粉色荷叶边飘带滑雪连体裤
description: 粉色荷叶边短上身 + 黑色阔腿裤的连体滑雪服：泡泡袖、层层荷叶边，黑色飘带和金色纽扣点缀，黑色立领。看起来像两件，其实是一件，穿脱方便，拍照特别出片。尺码 S。
descriptionEn: A ski jumpsuit that looks like two pieces: a cropped pink top with puff sleeves, layered ruffles, black ribbons and gold buttons, attached to black wide-leg pants. Easy to put on and super photogenic. Size S.

name: 棕粉撞色滑雪服 + 小猫印花雪裤套装
nameEn: Brown & Pink Ski Jacket + Kitty Print Pants Set
description:
官方款名：假两件棕粉撞色滑雪服 + 可爱小猫印花工装滑雪裤
巧克力棕外套，肩袖一道粉色撞色条，领口做成假两件的层次感；配浅粉色工装雪裤，满印黑色小猫和 G 字母。复古又可爱。尺码 S。
descriptionEn:
Official names: Faux Two-Piece Brown & Pink Ski Jacket + Cute Kitty Print Cargo Snow Pants
A chocolate-brown jacket with a pink contrast stripe across the shoulders and sleeves and a layered faux two-piece collar, paired with pale pink cargo pants printed all over with black kitties and G letters. Retro and cute. Size S.
